user.description: Select the entities to show in the GramTrack app's Home screen sensor strip. You can change this any time from Configure.

data_description.layout_dashboard: Optional. The GramTrack app's Home mirrors this dashboard's tile cards, one section per building. Enter the part of the dashboard's address after the first slash; leave empty to turn this off.
